  <description
               value="Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Quantitative antigen and antibody tests: Serology qualitative — threshold presence of a pathogen antibody or antigen', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. The qualitative counterpart (ordinal/semi-quantitative presence). Belongs to 'specific determination' in the 2027 module, listed here for the review split quantitative vs qualitative. Parts: LOINC enumeration (2785, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (11), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `&lt;&lt; 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118589004 |Threshold (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705057003 |Presence (property) (qualifier value)|), 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = (&lt;&lt; 312301006 |Infective organism antibody (substance)| OR &lt;&lt; 116633006 |Microbial antigen (substance)|)`"/>
  <jurisdiction>
    <coding>
      <system value="urn:iso:std:iso:3166"/>
      <code value="DE"/>
      <display value="Germany"/>
    </coding>
  </jurisdiction>
